about: Members come from cargo metadata, their manifests found under the workspace root it reports wherever the run's root is, and publish is read from metadata (publish = [] is never published): here one member keeps its own lint table (AF10)

files.b/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "b"
publish = false

[lints]
workspace = true

[lints.clippy]
panic = "allow"
